title.narrative: Increasing Sierra Leone's Competitiveness through Enhanced Productivity and Trade Compliance in Selected Value Chains

description.narrative: Implemented by UNIDO and with ITC involvement, the project will contribute to the progressive achievement of SDG target 8-''promote inclusive and sustainable economic growth, employment and decent work for all'' and SDG target 9- ''Build resilient infrastructure, promote sustainable industrialization and foster innovation ''. It is structured to directly support value chains (cassava, cocoa and oil palm) at both national and regional levels, promote regional linkages between private sector operators and organisations as well as improve the regional business environment.. The proposed activities are grouped to target different types of stakeholders ranging from private sector, business support organisations and public sector entities to improve West Africa Competitiveness.
